description: This file contains unit tests for the LoadBalancerEncoder component in the QUIC protocol implementation, including test vectors, configuration updates, and edge case handling.

classes.name: LoadBalancerEncoderPeer
classes.description: Provides a static method to set the number of nonces left in the encoder for testing purposes.

classes.name: TestLoadBalancerEncoderVisitor
classes.description: A test implementation of LoadBalancerEncoderVisitorInterface that tracks configuration add and delete events.

classes.name: TestRandom
classes.description: A deterministic implementation of QuicRandom that returns predefined 64-bit values for testing.

classes.name: LoadBalancerEncoderTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for LoadBalancerEncoder unit tests, includes a TestRandom instance.

classes.name: LoadBalancerEncoderTestCase
classes.description: A struct representing test vectors with configuration, connection ID, and server ID.

methods.name: SetNumNoncesLeft
methods.description: Sets the number of nonces remaining in the LoadBalancerEncoder for testing.

methods.name: ~TestLoadBalancerEncoderVisitor
methods.description: Destructor for the test visitor class.

methods.name: OnConfigAdded
methods.description: Called when a configuration is added; increments counter and updates current config ID.

methods.name: OnConfigChanged
methods.description: Called when a configuration is changed; updates counters and verifies old config ID.

methods.name: OnConfigDeleted
methods.description: Called when a configuration is deleted; updates counters and resets current config ID.

methods.name: num_adds
methods.description: Returns the number of configuration additions.

methods.name: num_deletes
methods.description: Returns the number of configuration deletions.

methods.name: RandUint64
methods.description: Returns the next 64-bit value from the predefined sequence or a base value.

methods.name: RandBytes
methods.description: Fills a buffer with random bytes based on the predefined sequence.

methods.name: InsecureRandBytes
methods.description: Fills a buffer with random bytes, same as RandBytes.

methods.name: InsecureRandUint64
methods.description: Returns a 64-bit random value.

methods.name: AddNextValues
methods.description: Adds two 64-bit values to the sequence of predefined values.

methods.name: LoadBalancerEncoderTest
methods.description: A test fixture class for LoadBalancerEncoder tests, includes a TestRandom instance.

methods.name: MakeServerId
methods.description: Creates a LoadBalancerServerId from a byte array and length.

methods.name: UnencryptedConnectionIdTestVectors
methods.description: Tests generating connection IDs with unencrypted configuration using predefined test vectors.

methods.name: FollowSpecExample
methods.description: Tests the encoder against an example from the draft specification.

methods.name: EncoderTestVectors
methods.description: Validates the encoder against multiple test vectors from the draft specification.

methods.name: RunOutOfNonces
methods.description: Tests behavior when the encoder runs out of nonces.

methods.name: UnroutableConnectionId
methods.description: Tests generating an unroutable connection ID.

methods.name: NonDefaultUnroutableConnectionIdLength
methods.description: Tests generating an unroutable connection ID with a non-default length.

methods.name: DeleteConfigWhenNoConfigExists
methods.description: Tests deleting a config when none exists.

methods.name: AddConfig
methods.description: Tests adding a new configuration.

methods.name: UpdateConfig
methods.description: Tests updating the configuration.

methods.name: DeleteConfig
methods.description: Tests deleting the current configuration.

methods.name: DeleteConfigNoVisitor
methods.description: Tests deleting config when no visitor is provided.

methods.name: MaybeReplaceConnectionIdReturnsNoChange
methods.description: Tests that no replacement occurs when conditions are not met.

methods.name: MaybeReplaceConnectionIdReturnsChange
methods.description: Tests that connection ID is replaced when conditions are met.

methods.name: GenerateNextConnectionIdReturnsNoChange
methods.description: Tests that no new connection ID is generated when not applicable.

methods.name: GenerateNextConnectionIdReturnsChange
methods.description: Tests that a new connection ID is generated when conditions are met.

methods.name: ConnectionIdLengthsEncoded
methods.description: Tests encoding of connection ID lengths based on configuration.
